metric: Sum of current download_count for SHARPpy-Reimagined-*.exe and SHARPpy-Reimagined-*.zip assets on published releases, including legacy and beta releases. Excludes latest.json, signatures, checksums, manifests, dependency lists, SBOMs and Python wheels. Repeat and automated requests may count; these are not unique users or installs. Removed or replaced assets can reduce later totals.
